hardware: RTX 5090 on the existing dedicated host
checkpoint_rule: latest checkpoint fully written by deadline; never highest evaluated score
timing_origin: monotonic launcher timestamp immediately before starting the native process
annealing_schedule: existing linear step schedule over 13312000 decisions, common across families

development.selection: maximum three-seed mean wins at 60 seconds; ties use fixed recipe order
development.other_settings: ocean/connect4cnn/compare.ini, exact source/config hashes frozen before launch

confirmation.recipe_rule: one development-selected frozen recipe per family; no adjustment using confirmation outcomes
confirmation.success_rule: ours at 60 seconds exceeds each reference at 30/45/60 seconds: all nine one-sided Bonferroni-adjusted paired bootstrap lower bounds > 0 and all mean differences >= .05
confirmation.failure_rule: preserve failures; if planned outcomes missing, no complete-panel superiority conclusion
confirmation.stopping: fixed 40 paired seeds; no significance-driven additions or substitutions

gates: reviewably reconciled source and resolved baseline identities
validated checkpoint availability receipts and deadline selection
fixed-allocation Connect4 evaluation with per-episode accounting
complete equal-opportunity learner challenge with all failures retained
selected recipes/source hashes frozen before any confirmation outcomes
